spans.s: पिंग (I) a. (f. गा) Reddish-brown, tawny, K.S.vii.33.
पिंग (II) m. 1. The tawny colour; 2. a buffalo; 3. a rat.
पिंग (I) a. (f. गा) Reddish-brown, tawny, K.S.vii.33.
पिंगा f. 1. A kind of yellow pigment; 2. turmeric; 3. saffron; 4. an epithet of Chaṇḍikā.
पिंग-अक्ष (I) a. red-eyed.
पिंग-अक्ष (II) m. 1. an ape; 2. an epithet of Śiva.
पिंग-ईक्षण m. an epithet of Śiva.
पिंग-ईश m. an epithet of fire.
पिंग-कपिशा f. a species of cockroach.
पिंग-चक्षुस् m. a crab.
पिंग-जट m. an epithet of Śiva.
पिंग-सार m. yellow orpiment.
पिंग-स्फटिक m. a kind of gem (गोमेद).
पिंगल (I) a. (f. ला) Reddish-brown, tawny, R.xii.71.

पिंगल (II) m. 1. The tawny colour; 2. fire; 3. a monkey; 4. a kind of snake; 5. a small owl; 6. an ichneumon; 7. an attendant on the sun; 8. name of a sage who is supposed to be the father of Sanskrit prosody, छंदोज्ञाननिधिं जघान मकरो वेलातटे पिंगलम् Panch.ii.
पिंगल (III) n. 1. Brass; 2. yellow orpiment.
पिंगल (I) a. (f. ला) Reddish-brown, tawny, R.xii.71.
पिंगला f. 1. A kind of owl; 2. a kind of metal; 3. a particular vessel of the body; 4. name of a courtezan remarkable for her piety and good conduct. See Bh.V.iv.12.
पिंगल-अक्ष m. an epithet of Śiva.
पिंगलिका f. 1. A kind of owl; 2. a sort of crane.
पिंगाश (I) m. 1. The headman of a village; 2. a kind of fish.
पिंगाश (II) n. Virgin gold.
पिंगाशी f. The indigo-plant.
पिंज (I) m. 1. The moon; 2. a species of camphor; 3. killing, slaughter; 4. heap.
पिंज (II) n. Strength, power.
पिंजट m. The mucus of the eyes.
पिंजन n. A bow-shaped instrument used for cleaning cotton.
पिंजर (I) a. (f. रा) Gold-coloured, R.xviii.40, Rt.v.8.
पिंजर (II) m. 1. The reddish-brown colour; 2. the yellow colour.
पिंजर (III) n. 1. Gold; 2. a cage; 3. yellow orpiment; 4. a skeleton.
पिंजर (I) a. (f. रा) Gold-coloured, R.xviii.40, Rt.v.8.
पिंजरक n. Orpiment.
पिंजरित a. (f. ता) Coloured yellow.
पिंजरित a. (f. ता) Coloured yellow.
पिंजल (I) a. (f. ला) Overcome with terror, panic-struck (as an army).
पिंजल (II) n. 1. Yellow orpiment; 2. the leaf of the kuśa gross.
पिंजल (I) a. (f. ला) Overcome with terror, panic-struck (as an army).
पिंजाल n. Gold.
पिंजिका f. A roll of cotton from which threads are spun.
पिंजूष m. The wax of the ear.
पिंजेट m. The excretion of the eyes.
पिंजोला f. The rustling of leaves.
पिंड (I) a. (f. डी) 1. Solid; 2. compact, close.

पिंड (II) m. 1. A ball, a globe, Yaj.ii.105; 2. a roundish lump of food, a morsel, R.ii.59; 3. a ball of meal offered to the Manes, Bg.i.41, R.i.66; 4. food in general; 5. livelihood, subsistence; 6. alms; 7. flesh, meat; 8. the fetus in an early stage of jestation; 9. the body, एकांतविध्वंसिषु मद्विधानां पिंडेष्वनास्था खलु भौतिकेषु R.ii.57; 10. the frontal sinus of an elephant; 11. a heap, a collection; 12. a shed in front of the door; 13. incense, frank-incense; 14. sum, total (in arithmetic); 15. thickness (in geometry).
पिंड (III) n. 1. Power, strength; 2. fresh butter; 3. an army; 4. iron.
पिंड (I) a. (f. डी) 1. Solid; 2. compact, close.
पिंडी f. The same as पिंडि q.v.
पिंडि f. 1. The nave of a wheel; 2. the calf of the leg; 3. a round mass; 4. the Aśoka tree; 5. a house. (Also पिंडिका.)
पिंड-अन्वाहार्य a. to be eaten after the funeral cake has been offered. See M.iii.123.
पिंड-अन्वाहार्यक n. a meal in honour of the Manes.
पिंड-अभ्र n. hail.
पिंड-अयस n. steel.
पिंड-अलक्तक m. a red dye.
पिंड-अशन, -आश, -आशक, -आशिन् m. a beggar.
पिंड-अशन, -आश, -आशक, -आशिन् m. a beggar.
पिंडस m. A beggar, a mendicant maintaining himself on alms.
पिंड-अशन, -आश, -आशक, -आशिन् m. a beggar.
पिंड-अशन, -आश, -आशक, -आशिन् m. a beggar.
पिंड-उदकक्रिया f. an oblation of cakes and water to the deceased.
पिंड-उद्धरण n. participation in funeral offerings.
पिंड-गोस m. gum, myrrh.
पिंड-तैल n. incense.
पिंड-तैलक m. incense.
पिंड-द (I) a. 1. one who supplies with bread, श्वा पिंडदस्य कुरुते गजपुंगवस्तु धीरं विलोकयति चाटुशतैश्च भुंक्ते Bhartr.ii.31; 2. qualified to give the funeral cake to deceased ancestors, Yaj.ii.132.
पिंड-द (II) m. 1. the nearest male relation who offers the funeral cake; 2. a master, a patron.
पिंड-दान n. 1. presentation of the obsequial cake; 2. the funeral oblation made to deceased ancestors on the evening of the new-moon day.
पिंड-निर्वपण n. presenting obsequial cakes to the Manes.
पिंड-पात m. collecting or giving alms, M.M.i.
पिंड-पातिक m. one who lives on alms.
पिंड-पाद, -पाद्य m. an elephant.
पिंड-पाद, -पाद्य m. an elephant.
पिंड-पुष्प (I) m. 1. the aśoka tree; 2. the China rose; 3. the pomegranate.
पिंड-पुष्प (II) n. 1. the blossom of the aśoka tree; 2. the flower of the China rose; 3. a lotus.
पिंड-भाज् m. pl. the Manes.
पिंड-भृति f. livelihood, means of subsistence.
पिंड-मूल, -मूलक n. a carrot.
पिंड-मूल, -मूलक n. a carrot.
पिंड-यज्ञ m. the presentation of obsequial cakes to the deceased ancestors, Yaj.iii.16.
पिंड-लेप m. the fragments of the obsequial cake which cling to the hand; (these are offered to the three ancestors immediately preceding the great-grand-father).
पिंड-लोप m. interruption in offering the funeral cakes.
पिंड-संबंध m. relationship between a living person and one deceased, near enough to qualify the former to offer the obsequial cake to the latter.
पिंडक (I) m.n. 1. A lump, a ball; 2. a lump of food; 3. the calf of the leg; 4. incense; 5. carrot.
पिंडक (II) m. A goblin, a demon.
पिंडन n. Forming globes.
पिंडल m. A bridge, a cause-way.
पिंडात m. Incense.
पिंडार m. 1. A religious mendicant; 2. a cowherd; 3. a buffalo-herdsman; 4. the vikankata tree.
पिंडित a. (f. ता) 1. Thick, lumpish; 2. heaped together; 3. added, multiplied; 4. counted, numbered.
पिंडित a. (f. ता) 1. Thick, lumpish; 2. heaped together; 3. added, multiplied; 4. counted, numbered.
पिंडिन् m. 1. A beggar; 2. one who offers obsequial cakes to the Manes.
पिंडिल m. 1. A bridge, a cause-way; 2. an astronomer or astrologer.
पिंडी-पुष्प m. the Aśoka tree.
पिंडी-लेप m. a kind of unguent.
पिंडी-शूर m. a cowardly boaster, a braggart.
पिंडीर (I) a. (f. रा) Sapless, arid, dry.
पिंडीर (II) m. 1. The pomegranate tree; 2. cuttle-fish-bone, considered to be the foam of the sea. Cf. डिंडीर.
पिंडीर (I) a. (f. रा) Sapless, arid, dry.
पिंडोलि f. Fragments dropped from the mouth.
पिनद्ध a. (f. द्धा) 1. Fastened, tied on; 2. dressed; 3. concealed; 4. pierced, penetrated.
पिनद्ध a. (f. द्धा) 1. Fastened, tied on; 2. dressed; 3. concealed; 4. pierced, penetrated.
पिनाक m.n. 1. The bow of Śiva, K.S.iii.10; 2. a trident; 3. a shower of dust.
पिनाक-गोप्तृ, -धृक्, -धृत्, -पाणि m. an epithet of Śiva, K.S.iii.10.
पिनाक-गोप्तृ, -धृक्, -धृत्, -पाणि m. an epithet of Śiva, K.S.iii.10.
पिनाक-गोप्तृ, -धृक्, -धृत्, -पाणि m. an epithet of Śiva, K.S.iii.10.
पिनाक-गोप्तृ, -धृक्, -धृत्, -पाणि m. an epithet of Śiva, K.S.iii.10.
पिनाकिन् m. An epithet of Śiva, K.S.v.77.
पीन a. (f. ना) 1. Flat, fleshy; 2. full, round; 3. corpulent, thick, plump; 4. profuse, much, excessive.
पीन a. (f. ना) 1. Flat, fleshy; 2. full, round; 3. corpulent, thick, plump; 4. profuse, much, excessive.
पीन-ऊध्नी f. a cow with swelling udders.
पीन-वक्षस् a. full-breasted, having a full breast.
पीनस m. 1. Cold affecting the nose; 2. cough.
